name: Interval Families with Endpoint Cubes Are Recursively Peripheral
statement: Let $\mathcal I_L$ contain the empty set and all intervals of the linear order $[L]$. For $0\le a,b\le L$, the class $K_{L,a,b}=\mathcal I_L\cup2^{[a]}\cup2^{\{L-b+1,\ldots,L\}}$ is recursively peripheral, and its cube complement is recursively peripheral whenever nonempty.
proof: First inductively peel a prefix family together with its initial cube. For $K_{L,a,b}$, splitting on the first coordinate yields a smaller class of the same form and one such prefix family, with nested shores. The peripheral recursion completes the induction; complement closure gives the final statement.
